crime: Every evening at dusk, {WITCH_NAME}'s roommate walked down to the lake shore and posted the sunset to the prison chat from her phone, so the girls inside could see it too. Since the first cold night, she had worn {WITCH_NAME}'s cardigan on every walk.
One evening, before her walk, she folded the cardigan in the lounge and handed it back. "It's warm enough now. Thank you for keeping me warm all winter."
Long ago, {WITCH_NAME}'s mother had returned the neighbor's ladder and sugar tin, and {WITCH_NAME} had helped carry them back. By the next morning, her mother was gone.

At the prison entrance, {WITCH_NAME} pulled the cardigan on and watched her roommate walk down to the lake. Before the sun set, she fixed her eyes on the shore beside the girl and was standing there. She closed both hands around her roommate's throat and did not let go until she was still.

Before sunset she was sitting among the girls in the lounge, the cardigan on, and she kept it on all evening, until the body was found. As the sun went down, she slipped out to the entrance hall for half a minute. At the same moment, the prisoners in the lounge saw her roommate's sunset photo arrive in the chat, just as it did every evening.
In the trial court, the prisoners ruled that the girl had been strangled on the shore after sending the sunset, while {WITCH_NAME} had never been gone for more than half a minute.

Then one prisoner spotted a dark knit cuff in the corner of the last sunset: the cardigan that had been given back. Every earlier sunset was clean. They realized {WITCH_NAME} had strangled her roommate first, then spent her half minute standing at the lake, taking the sunset herself.
fields.epitaph: Some people hand a thing back fully meaning to borrow it again.
execution: The execution stand raises an iron slab with her chained on her back, beneath a huge iron hand full of borrowed things. One after another, the hand gives them back, setting each on her chest: an iron ladder, then an iron sugar tin. Last, it lays a folded iron cardigan on top. Warm enough now. Then the hand rises away into the dark. Her eyes follow it until she no longer stirs.

magic.name: One Glance Away
magic.text: She can step instantly to any spot she looks at.
